content: avcodec_decode_video2/audio4 (old decode API) removed; avcodec_send_packet/avcodec_receive_frame (introduced FFmpeg 3.1, 2016) is the only decode API in 7.x/8.x/9.x. AVCodecParameters.coded_side_data (stream-level side data incl. mastering-display/CLL/DOVI config) was added to libavcodec 60.30.100 = FFmpeg 6.1 (Oct 2023) — this is the real version floor for reading HDR static metadata off codecpar rather than per-frame AVFrame side data.
